text:
A sound wave travels from a medium in one state into the same medium but in another state.
This causes the speed of the wave to change from approximately 300m/s to approximately
3000m/s.
Between which two states is the sound wave travelling?
A
gas to solid
B
liquid to gas
C
liquid to solid
D
solid to liquid
subject: Physics
